subject: per-phy-u-fund
title: PER.PHY.U.FUND.-----WO.EXP.PRI.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 474 (TRF(II)-10). PER-PHY-U-FUND (perceived physical universe fundamental) is the subject; WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars), C-CONT (composite continuance) and EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From COS-P: RE-CONT (recontinuance). From C-CONT: COS-P-2 (cosmic particulars) and TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From EXT-FT: COS-P-3 (cosmic particulars). From RE-CONT: PRI-INFO (principle information). From TH-CONT: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From COS-P-3: TECH-DY (technological dynamics). From TECH-DY: APL-DT (application dictates).
